sql: WITH children AS (SELECT r.id,r.type,r.kind,substr(r.name,1,512) AS name,r.home_id,r.updated_at_ms,COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=r.id AND r.type='Document' AND COALESCE(r.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),r.home_id) AS parent_id,(SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=r.id AND f.key='icon' LIMIT 1) AS icon, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=r.id AND f.key='cover' LIMIT 1) AS cover, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=r.id AND f.key='sort_key' LIMIT 1) AS sort_key FROM records r WHERE (r.home_id=?1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM links nesting WHERE nesting.source_id=r.id AND nesting.target_id=?1 AND nesting.relationship='part_of')) AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.type IN ('Collection', 'Document', 'WorkItem') AND COALESCE(r.kind, '') NOT IN ('attachment', 'query', 'selection') AND (COALESCE(r.kind, '') <> 'artifact' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facet_values m WHERE m.record_id = r.id AND m.key = 'runtime' AND m.value IN ('native.mdx.v1', 'native.mdx.v2'))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=r.id AND a.key='archived')) SELECT * FROM children WHERE parent_id=?1 AND (?3='' OR (sort_key IS NULL) > (CASE WHEN json_valid(?2) THEN json_extract(?2,'$[0]') ELSE NULL END IS NULL) OR ((sort_key IS NULL)=(CASE WHEN json_valid(?2) THEN json_extract(?2,'$[0]') ELSE NULL END IS NULL) AND (COALESCE(sort_key,'') COLLATE BINARY > COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(?2) THEN json_extract(?2,'$[0]') ELSE NULL END,'') COLLATE BINARY OR (COALESCE(sort_key,'')=COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(?2) THEN json_extract(?2,'$[0]') ELSE NULL END,'') AND (name COLLATE NOCASE > CASE WHEN json_valid(?2) THEN json_extract(?2,'$[1]') ELSE ?2 END OR (name COLLATE NOCASE=CASE WHEN json_valid(?2) THEN json_extract(?2,'$[1]') ELSE ?2 END AND id>?3)))))) ORDER BY (sort_key IS NULL),sort_key COLLATE BINARY,name COLLATE NOCASE,id LIMIT 200

SELECT r.id, r.type, r.kind, r.name, r.lifecycle, r.summary, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.updated_at_ms, r.home_id, COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=r.id AND r.type='Document' AND COALESCE(r.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),r.home_id) AS parent_id, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=r.id AND f.key='icon' LIMIT 1) AS icon, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=r.id AND f.key='cover' LIMIT 1) AS cover, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=r.id AND f.key='sort_key' LIMIT 1) AS sort_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id = r.id AND a.key = 'archived') AS archived, (SELECT m.value FROM facet_values m WHERE m.record_id = r.id AND m.key = 'runtime') AS runtime, h1.name AS h1n, h1.type AS h1t, COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h1.id AND h1.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h1.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h1.home_id) AS h1h, h2.id AS h2, h2.name AS h2n, h2.type AS h2t, COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h2.id AND h2.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h2.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h2.home_id) AS h2h, h3.id AS h3, h3.name AS h3n, h3.type AS h3t, COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h3.id AND h3.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h3.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h3.home_id) AS h3h, h4.id AS h4, h4.name AS h4n, h4.type AS h4t, COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h4.id AND h4.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h4.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h4.home_id) AS h4h, h5.id AS h5, h5.name AS h5n, h5.type AS h5t, COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h5.id AND h5.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h5.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h5.home_id) AS h5h FROM records r LEFT JOIN records h1 ON h1.id = COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=r.id AND r.type='Document' AND COALESCE(r.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),r.home_id) AND h1.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN records h2 ON h2.id = COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h1.id AND h1.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h1.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h1.home_id) AND h2.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN records h3 ON h3.id = COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h2.id AND h2.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h2.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h2.home_id) AND h3.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN records h4 ON h4.id = COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h3.id AND h3.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h3.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h3.home_id) AND h4.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN records h5 ON h5.id = COALESCE((SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id WHERE l.source_id=h4.id AND h4.type='Document' AND COALESCE(h4.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND l.relationship='part_of' AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1),h4.home_id) AND h5.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.id = ?1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=records.id AND f.key='icon' LIMIT 1) AS icon, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=records.id AND f.key='cover' LIMIT 1) AS cover, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id=records.id AND f.key='sort_key' LIMIT 1) AS sort_key, id, type, kind, substr(name,1,160) AS name, home_id, updated_at_ms FROM records WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND type IN ('Document','WorkItem') AND COALESCE(kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=records.id AND a.key='archived') ORDER BY updated_at_ms DESC, id ASC LIMIT 200

WITH visible AS (SELECT r.* FROM records r JOIN records folder ON folder.id=r.home_id AND folder.type='Collection' AND COALESCE(folder.kind,'') NOT IN ('query','selection') AND folder.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.home_id = ?1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.type IN ('Collection', 'Document', 'WorkItem') AND COALESCE(r.kind, '') NOT IN ('attachment', 'query', 'selection') AND (COALESCE(r.kind, '') <> 'artifact' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facet_values m WHERE m.record_id = r.id AND m.key = 'runtime' AND m.value IN ('native.mdx.v1', 'native.mdx.v2'))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=r.id AND a.key='archived')) SELECT count(*) AS total FROM visible LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE walk(id,depth,path,cycle) AS (SELECT r.id,0,'|'||r.id||'|',0 FROM records r WHERE r.id=?1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.id,w.depth+1,w.path||p.id||'|',instr(w.path,'|'||p.id||'|')>0 FROM walk w JOIN records p ON p.id IN (SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id JOIN records r ON r.id=l.source_id WHERE l.source_id=w.id AND l.relationship='part_of' AND r.type='Document' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(r.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived') UNION ALL SELECT r.home_id FROM records r WHERE r.id=w.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT l.target_id FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id=l.target_id JOIN records r ON r.id=l.source_id WHERE l.source_id=w.id AND l.relationship='part_of' AND r.type='Document' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(r.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND p.type='Document' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.kind,'') NOT IN ('artifact','attachment','query','selection') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_values a WHERE a.record_id=p.id AND a.key='archived')) LIMIT 257) WHERE w.cycle=0 AND w.depth<32 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.id<>'native:root' LIMIT 257) SELECT id,depth,cycle FROM walk ORDER BY depth,id LIMIT 257
